verdict.rationale: Browserbase's dashboard Optimize tool reads an Agent run's event history and helps turn it into a better system prompt or a reusable Stagehand script. That is an in-product, AI-driven suggestion built from the user's own run data, but it is narrow: limited to agent-run optimization rather than general insights. Missing for 10: broader AI insights across the user's session and usage data, documented depth of the suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Optimize tool lives in the Agent run view in the dashboard...reads the run's event history and helps you turn what the Agent did into a better system prompt.
Use the Optimize tool to turn a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script.
